title: Troubleshooting, Recovery, and Diagnostics
learning_outcomes: Use a disciplined evidence-first method to diagnose boot, process, storage, network, software, and hardware faults.
Apply the module concepts to a safe example and verify the observed result.
Identify at least one distribution/version difference or operational safety concern.
